title: Senior HR Analyst
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior HR Analyst
About the Role  

  

The People Analyst will be a key member of the Regional People Data \& Analytics team, delivering workforce insights, analytics, and strategic decision support across multiple business units globally. This role combines analytics, data management, reporting, program management, and emerging AI capabilities to enable data\-driven talent decisions across Mastercard.  

  

The ideal candidate is a detail\-oriented problem solver with strong SQL and data modeling expertise, a passion for data quality, and an interest in leveraging Generative AI to improve workforce analytics and business outcomes. This individual will help transform complex people data into actionable insights while driving consistency, scalability, and innovation across reporting and analytics solutions.  

  

Key Responsibilities  

Workforce Analytics \& Reporting  

Serve as the primary point of contact for operational reporting, workforce metrics, and analytics requests from global stakeholders.  

Partner with business leaders to understand underlying business challenges and translate them into actionable analytical solutions.  

Collaborate with the Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) CoE to support monthly headcount reporting, forecasting, and workforce analysis.  

Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations that provide meaningful workforce insights.  

Data Management \& Quality  

Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of workforce data across systems and reporting solutions.  

Partner with HR Systems, Data Management, and Engineering teams to identify and resolve data quality issues.  

Establish controls and validation processes to improve trust and reliability of workforce metrics.  

Drive data governance standards and ensure compliance with privacy and security requirements for people data.  

Data Modeling \& Analytics Engineering  

Design and maintain scalable analytical data models to support reporting, self\-service analytics, AI use cases, and workforce planning.  

Apply dimensional modeling principles and create efficient data structures for workforce analytics.  

Leverage SQL to query, analyze, validate, and optimize large and complex datasets.  

Collaborate with Data Engineers and Analysts to improve analytical data foundations and reporting capabilities.  

AI \& Innovation  

Explore and leverage Generative AI solutions to improve reporting efficiency, automate insights generation, and enhance workforce analytics.  

Identify opportunities to incorporate AI\-driven capabilities into reporting, analytics, and decision support processes.  

Partner with analytics teams to evaluate emerging technologies and improve the employee analytics experience.  

  

All About You  

Essential Qualifications  

Experience working with organizational, workforce, HR, or people\-related data.  

Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes behind business questions.  

Advanced SQL skills with experience querying, analyzing, troubleshooting, and optimizing large datasets.  

Strong understanding of data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling, relationships, keys, hierarchies, and analytical data structures.  

Proven ability to improve data quality, data integrity, and reporting accuracy across multiple systems and data sources.  

Advanced Excel experience including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, formulas, conditional formatting, charts, and data analysis.  

Ability to communicate complex analytical findings to non\-technical audiences.  

Experience building scalable reporting solutions, dashboards, and self\-service analytics capabilities.  

Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively across global teams and multiple time zones.  

Ability to work within data governance, privacy, and compliance frameworks.  

Flexible, proactive, and able to adapt to changing business priorities.  

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.  

  

Preferred Qualifications  

Experience with HRIS platforms, preferably Workday.  

Experience managing and analyzing structured and unstructured data using SQL, Python, R, or similar technologies.  

Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Domo, or similar platforms.  

Familiarity with ETL and data integration tools such as Alteryx, Informatica, or similar technologies.  

Exposure to Generative AI technologies and AI\-powered analytics solutions.  

Experience designing analytical datasets, semantic layers, feature stores, or enterprise reporting models.  

Understanding of data governance, metadata management, and enterprise data quality frameworks.  

Experience influencing stakeholders and driving adoption across large, matrixed organizations.  

Knowledge of workforce planning, talent analytics, organizational effectiveness, or employee experience analytics.**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: ACCOUNT/CLUSTER ACCOUNT/PRACTICE HRBP L2(CONTRACT)
description:
**Job Title:** ACCOUNT/CLUSTER ACCOUNT/PRACTICE HRBP L2(CONTRACT)
  
**City:** Pune
  
**State/Province:** Maharashtra
  
**Posting Start Date:** 9/9/26
  
**Wipro Limited (NYSE:** WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.
  
  

Role Purpose
  
The purpose of the Practice Head role is to enhance organizational capability within the practice they lead by providing strategic direction, enabling design and execution of sustainable, targeted programs, policies and processes that enable or sustain various aspects of talent development, engagement and retention in Wipro.
  
  

͏
  
  

Do
  
  

* Strategy Development and Deployment
* Support development of overall practice charter for the organization
* Achieve talent capability improvements by creating and deploying annual plan based on business strategy, requirement analysis and emerging business realities
* Determine optimal structure and roles in the team for increased efficiency and effectiveness
* Program / Intervention Design and Development
* Address specific practice related challenges by working with business leaders to understand the problem, designing and deploying specific programs, processes or interventions.
* Drive contextualization as per unit requirements, in programs deployed
* Direct future capability building within the practice by developing new programs in consultation with business leaders, academia and external parties
* Increase effectiveness of existing programs, policies or processes by commissioning and overseeing program redesign and refresh
* Enhance the team design and delivery capabilities by devising and implementing frameworks for program effectiveness measurement
* Team Management and Development
* Provide overall direction and guidance to the team for program design and delivery
* Complete all people processes for the team such as performance Nxt, WLQ etc. as applicable
* Build team capability by reviewing team performance and recommending learning / development intervention in consultation with the concerned teams
* Support \& motivate the team by \-
* Coaching team members to build expertise and skill within the function
* Driving focus in the team by aligning them with annual plans and performance goals
* Encouraging team to undertake self\-development and capability building.
